opening.argument: The video is plainly presented as entertainment: its title identifies it as a "Movie Scene," and the description explicitly places the footage in the movie Ami Je Ke Tomar. The staged confrontation between a man and woman, including one holding a sheet of paper, is consistent with a dramatized scene about interpersonal conflict and an accusation concerning a death. A posed couple beside stylized Bengali title text further reinforces a film context. The request to subscribe to the SVF YouTube channel is ordinary audience engagement, with no indication of payment, investment, credential collection, deception, losses, or other harmful outcome.
